messages:
Rae (People Ops): @channel heads-up: Oakland announces a single-day full on-ramp closure to the Bay Bridge on Thu Jun 10 (06:00-10:30). Expect big delays from East Bay. Options below — please pick in the short form by Tue EOD: https://tinyurl.com/bridge-june10

Leo (Facilities): We set up an overflow coworking space at the Emeryville satellite (20 seats). If you need a desk there, choose 'satellite' on the form. We'll provide coffee and lunch boxes.

Marta (Travel Ops): Shuttle plan: two AM runs from Jack London to HQ (06:45, 07:30) and two PM returns (17:15, 18:00). Shuttle seats limited; reserve with 'shuttle: yes' in the form. If shuttle fills, rideshare reimbursement up to $45 one-way.

Sam: If I drive from Walnut Creek, is parking available near the Emeryville site?

Leo (Facilities): Yes — short-term parking validated at Emeryville lot (free for Redwood staff that day). Add license plate in the form. No overnight parking.

Ivy: My daycare opens late that day. Any childcare help? :upside_down_face:

Rae (People Ops): We can fast-track a childcare stipend: up to $60 for the day. Mark "childcare" in the form and attach a short note in expenses after.

ShuttleBot: shuttle-bot created reservation link: "Oakland Bridge Shuttle" (AM slots: 06:45, 07:30). Please only reserve if you intend to ride.

Nina (Security): Security will staff Emeryville entry 06:30-19:00. If you're bringing an external vendor or guest, drop full name here for pre-clearance. All guests must show ID on entry.

Sam: If I WFH, do I still count it as a full workday? Manager expectation?

Rae (People Ops): Yes — WFH counts as normal. Managers: please coordinate critical onsite coverage if your team needs someone in the HQ that day. We'll publish an exceptions list Wed morning.

Ivy: Is there a quiet room at Emeryville? I have a conference call at 08:30.

Leo (Facilities): We'll reserve Conference B for quiet calls 08:00-10:30. If you need a room longer, add a note on the form and we'll try to adjust.

Marta (Travel Ops): Quick notes: reimburse rideshares up to $45 one-way if shuttle unavailable. If you book a hotel due to unusual transit issues, submit receipts with tag "bridge-closure" and we'll review.

Rae (People Ops): TL;DR: Fill the form by Tue EOD for shuttle/satellite/childcare/parking. Shuttle seats limited. Emeryville overflow open. We'll post final confirmations Wed morning. Stay safe and plan extra commute time :bus: :bridge_at_night:
